fact: On 20 May 2026 the Inspection générale des finances announced a move to systemic control based on data, digital traceability and AI, with digital infrastructure to 2028 costed at about 39 million USD of which 22 million USD is identified; the audit figures it cites (38,597 fictitious payroll agents) are not attributed to AI.
title: RDC : l'IGF migre vers l'IA pour renforcer le contrôle des finances publiques
